verdicts.title: Clifford index for reduced curves
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We extend the notion of Clifford index to reduced curves with planar singularities by considering rank 1 torsion free sheaves. We investigate the behaviour of the Clifford index with respect to the combinatorial properties of the curve and we show that Green's conjecture holds for certain classes of curves given by the union of two irreducible components.

verdicts.title: Minors of a random binary matroid
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Let ${\bf A}={\bf A}_{n,m,k}$ be a random $n\times m$ matrix over $\mathbf{GF}_2$ wher each column consists of $k$ randomly chosen ones. Let $M$ be an arbirary fixed binary matroid. We show that if $m/n$ and $k$ are sufficiently large then as $n\to\infty$ the binary matroid induced by {\bf A} contains $M$ as a minor.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract concerns minor containment in random binary matroids ('the binary matroid induced by A contains M as a minor'), with no mention of Clifford index, resolution width, SAT, or conflict graphs.
